symbols.name: NguFileInput
symbols.summary:
The control behind `type: 'file'` and `type: 'image'`: a file button and drop zone, and a
list of files with thumbnails, upload progress, Retry and Remove. Finished files are the
value. Uploads that failed and files that were refused (wrong type, too large) reach the
field as Signal Forms parse errors, so they block a submit until the user deals with them;
running uploads make `<ngu-form>` wait before it submits.

members.name: value
members.description:
The finished files, as `File` objects or what `upload` returned: a list when the spec sets
`multiple`, else one file or `null`. Bound by `[formField]`.

members.name: touch
members.description: Emits when the user leaves the file input, adds files or removes one.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Stops choosing and dropping files, and hides Retry and Remove. Bound by `[formField]`.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the files but stops adding and removing them, as `disabled`. Bound by `[formField]`.

members.name: required
members.description: Sets `required` on the file input. Bound by `[formField]`.

members.name: describedBy
members.description: Ids for the file input's `aria-describedby`: the field's hint and messages.

members.name: mode
members.description: `'image'` crops and resizes images before they are added.

members.name: add
members.description: Checks, edits (images) and adds or uploads chosen files.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the file input. Signal Forms calls it to focus the field.

members.name: upload
members.description:
Uploads each file as soon as it is chosen; the value then holds what it returns, and a
submit waits for uploads that are still running. Without it, the value holds `File` objects.

symbols.name: NguImageCropper
symbols.summary:
A modal dialog that crops an image to a frame. The image covers the frame; people drag it
or use the zoom and position sliders, so the dialog works with a keyboard alone. Escape
cancels. Native `<dialog>` keeps focus inside and returns it afterwards.

members.name: i18n
members.description: Texts of the dialog's title, hint, sliders and buttons; `<ngu-file-input>` passes the form's.

members.name: open
members.description: Shows the dialog for `file` and resolves with the cropped file, or `null` when cancelled.

members.name: crop
members.description:
Opens a crop dialog for each chosen image. `true` (default) keeps the image's own shape;
`{ aspect: 1 }` crops a square, `{ aspect: 16 / 9 }` a wide frame. `false` skips cropping.

members.name: maxWidth
members.description: Largest output width in pixels; wider images are scaled down.

members.name: maxHeight
members.description: Largest output height in pixels; taller images are scaled down.

members.name: output
members.description: Output format. Default `'image/jpeg'`, or `'image/png'` for PNG input.

members.name: quality
members.description: Output quality from 0 to 1, for JPEG and WebP. Default 0.9.

symbols.summary:
Registers `type: 'file'`, `type: 'image'` and `type: 'signature'`. Add it next to your other

